verifyIdentity: Verify your identity to access your savings circles.
passwordBody: Enter your CircuSave password. It is checked with the server and is not saved on this phone.
setupDescription: Require your device authentication when CircuSave opens.
recoveryBody: We will email a 6-digit code to {{email}}. To finish, CircuSave signs you out and you choose a new password. Choose Cancel to stay on this screen.
recoveryNoEmailBody: This account has no email address on this phone. Sign out from the login screen and use Forgot password there.
recoveryRateLimitBody: Too many requests. Please wait a moment before trying again.
recoveryNetworkBody: Unable to send the reset email. Check your connection and try again.
recoveryErrorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.
